description: Ayuntamiento de Barcelona: transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Barcelona. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Barcelona. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Estaciones de autobus de la ciudad de Barcelona; Información de rutas de autobús de la Estación Barcelona Norte de la c; Estado de los puertos de los puntos de recarga del de la ciudad de Bar; Estaciones marítimas de la ciudad de Barcelona. Formats seen: CSV, JSON, XML, GTFS, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
